motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: State change only (hover, progress, countdown). No entrance choreography.

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: Linear progress and countdown bar depletion.

label.purpose: Table/section captions. 11px uppercase, functional headers only.

mono.purpose: PINs, byte counts, speeds, countdowns, addresses. Tabular figures.

title.purpose: Panel headers, device names, queue heads. 15px semibold.

dos: Do set every PIN, byte count, speed, and countdown in tabular mono (tnum), verified against the phone screen at a glance.
Do keep consent in flow atop the queue with countdown and expiry parity (60s auto-decline).
Do theme selection, caret, focus rings, scrollbars, and numerals from this palette.
Do isolate destructive actions with empty space and focus-gating.
donts: Don't ship gradient text, glassmorphism, colored left-bars, hard offset shadows, or eyebrow kickers.
Don't use icon-plus-heading-plus-text cards as page structure or nested cards anywhere.
Don't put product UI in a display face or use mono for labels and decoration.
Don't modal what a drawer or inline row can do; settings and errors stay in flow.
Don't invent benchmarks, testimonials, or screenshots beyond the measured ~35 MB/s lab numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first adaptive console (light follows system, same seams and density).
High-density rows over cards; tables and queues, not icon grids.
Tabular mono for every number that must be compared or confirmed.
One accent; state colors earn their pixels.
narrative.overview: A dark blueprint schematic of the transfer itself: laptop left, phone right, a dashed animated link that goes live only when bytes move. Dotted-grid ground, 1px hairline panels, zero shadows, mono-first labels. Motion is the link telemetry, never decoration.

rules.body: Depth is a 1px seam (#2e333d) or one tonal step up. No drop shadows, no glows, no blur-as-decoration.
rules.name: The Seam-Not-Shadow Rule

rules.body: Blue means actionable-or-selected. Success, warning, and danger never borrow it and never decorate inactive states.
rules.name: The One-Accent Rule

rules.body: Any two numbers the user compares (PIN to phone screen, ack/total, countdown) share the mono face and tabular figures.
rules.name: The Numbers-Agree Rule

rules.body: Mono is for code, data, and measurement only — never for labels or decoration.
rules.name: The No-Costume Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow appears only when a layer leaves its container (drawer, toast, dropdown).
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
